measuredOn: 2026-10-12 (re-measured after terrain texture caching and removal of backdrop blur), Vite dev build, headless Chromium (Playwright 1.64), viewport 1440x900, DPR 1
method: Road-grid city sized for the target, residents welcomed through the UI, 4x until 07:15 (morning commute), then 1x and zoomed out so the whole grid is on screen. Six one-second samples of window.__tinyCityRenderer (fps = frames rendered per second; sceneUpdateMs = per-frame JS cost of the viewport ticker callback that syncs residents, culling and selection, excluding GPU rendering).

gpu.renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M2)

software.renderer: ANGLE SwiftShader (CPU rasterizer, as used by CI)
software.note: Before the fix the same run measured 10/8/7/5 fps: blurring the live canvas behind every floating panel and re-rasterizing ~8k terrain triangles each frame dominated. The terrain is now cached as one texture and panels are opaque. For reference, the pre-redesign main production build measured ~18 frames/s and 465 ms per canvas screenshot on the sample city under SwiftShader; this branch now measures ~25-30 frames/s and ~380 ms.
